inode_before.scope: Bounded inode metadata/capacity only, names hashed; no file contents, raw heap, cookies or keys; does not assign non-file heap allocations.

inode_after.scope: Bounded inode metadata/capacity only, names hashed; no file contents, raw heap, cookies or keys; does not assign non-file heap allocations.

pmm.caveat: Sampled PMM allocated frames, includes kernel/other residents; not exact peak or per-process RSS; heap backing reserved outside PMM is not counted.
